chunks: The Prophethood of Muḥammad (peace be upon him and his progeny):

In this way ages passed by and times rolled on, fathers passed away while sons took their places till Allāh deputised Muḥammad (peace be upon him and his progeny) as His Prophet, in fulfilment of His promise and in completion of His Prophethood. His pledge had been taken from the Prophets, his traits of character were well reputed and his birth was honourable. The people of the earth at this time were divided in different parties, their aims were separate and ways were diverse. They either likened Allāh with His creation or twisted His Names or turned to else than Him. Through Muḥammad (S) Allāh guided them out of wrong and with his efforts took them out of ignorance.

key_terms.مَبْعَثُ: The sending forth or mission of the Prophet
key_terms.مُلْحِدٍ: One who distorts or deviates (in names/attributes)

ai.seo_question: What was the state of humanity and the nature of God's promise before the mission of Prophet Muhammad?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this passage from Nahj al-Balagha underscores the concept of *al-Miṣāq* (the Covenant of the Prophets), where all previous prophets bore witness to Muhammad’s (PBUH) mission, fulfilling the divine promise made to them. It contextualizes the *Fatḥ* (opening) of prophethood as a necessary intervention in an era of *Jāhiliyyah* marked by theological deviation (*tashbīh*) and fragmented sects, positioning the Prophet as the ultimate guide who rescues humanity from spiritual ignorance.
